reimbursement_policies.evidence: Cesarean global obstetric package code; antepartum, cesarean delivery, and postpartum care are bundled for routine maternity claims.

Global obstetrical cesarean care is bundled into the maternity package when antepartum, delivery, and postpartum services are all provided by the same provider or group under the same TIN. Cesarean delivery is not separately reimbursed as part of the global package, except for assistant surgeons on cesarean deliveries with the appropriate modifier.

recommended_action.description:
Recommendation 1: For CPT 59510, bundle overlapping 59400 and 59430 when billed for the same pregnancy by the same provider group and same TIN, and reimburse 59510 only once per pregnancy. Peer: United Health applies a one unit global OB code limit around 59510, and Elevance external already uses same pregnancy, same provider group, same TIN, and once per pregnancy logic..

Recommendation 2: For CPT 59514, 59515, 59618, 59620, and 59622, allow separate reimbursement only when the claim meets delivery and postpartum only or delivery only logic within the same global maternity episode and is billed with assistant surgeon modifier 80, 81, 82, or AS; otherwise bundle these cesarean claims. Apply single gestation only, with multiple gestation exempt. Exempt: multiple gestation. Peer: Cigna and United Health both place 59514, 59515, 59618, 59620, and 59622 inside OB package logic, and Cigna requires assistant surgeon modifiers 80, 81, 82, or AS for separate cesarean assistant payment..
